div.h4: Observability & delivery spans every service above
One case, end to end - architecture flow

li.span: GCS: Video framesSurgical video lands in Cloud Storage.
POST /cases/openThe console opens a case; the orchestrator mints a case id and starts both sweeps.
Gemini 3.5: Vision + ReasoningPerception and three Error Detection agents call Gemini 3.5 over 5s windows. Weighted consensus — deterministic, no model — needs 2 of 3 before an error is raised.
Firestore: Graph persistenceEvery finding is written as a state graph rather than held in memory.
FireStore: transactional writeA transaction increments a monotonic seq, which drives the live SSE fan-out to the console.
Literature retrievalComplication Reasoning formulates its own query; three live APIs are merged by reciprocal rank fusion.
Gemini 3.5: Operative recordGemini 3.5 drafts the operative record from the case’s full reasoning graph.
ModelArmor: Screen the draftModel Armor screens the draft autonomously, before a surgeon is ever offered an Approve button.

FHIR: Verified write + readbackAfter the fail-closed Verification Gate and the surgeon's approval, the DocumentReference and any alert are written to a real external EHR and read back to confirm they landed.
HITL: Voice/text reviewThe surgeon opens SurgBot and reviews the completed case by voice or text.
MedASR: TranscribeMedASR transcribes the turn using medical-domain speech recognition.
ModelArmor: Screen the turnModel Armor template screens the transcript before any model sees it — one policy, both directions.
GEAP: async_stream_queryThe root agent dispatches to four specialist subagents on Agent Runtime.
Firestore: Reads completed casesSubagents read the completed case off the same Living State Graph SurgGraph wrote.
Chirp: Speech outChirp 3 HD streams the reply back to the surgeon.
MemoryBank: On approval onlyOnly when the surgeon approves the review does captured feedback become durable knowledge.
Gemini 3.5: Informs the next caseThat feedback is retrieved by similarity and injected as "advisory contex" into four SurgGraph agents on the next case — the loop that makes this one system.
CloudBuild: Push to mainA push to main runs the 10-step pipeline and deploys all four Cloud Run services.
